name: Success
overview: Scripture teaches that true success is rooted in a faithful relationship with God, as seen in the call to meditate on His law and obey His commandments to prosper and have good success (Joshua 1:8; Proverbs 3:1). Financial success and the power to gain wealth come from the LORD, who establishes His covenant through such blessings (Deuteronomy 8:18). Moreover, God’s presence ensures that no adversary can stand against His people, providing confidence and security throughout life (Joshua 1:5). Delight in the LORD aligns the desires of the heart with His will, further affirming that success flows from a joyful dependence on Him (Psalms 37:4).
